articles.title: Stream It Or Skip It: ‘The Silent Service’ Season 2 On Prime Video, In Which A Nuclear Submarine’s Captain Pursues World Peace With A Radical Proposition
articles.summary: The Silent Service: Season 2, a political thriller originally released in Japan as "The Silent Service: Great Battle of the Arctic Ocean," is now on Prime Video. This Japanese production delves into naval warfare and geopolitical tensions, particularly within the strategic Arctic region. It explores complex scenarios relevant to defence and international relations through a fictional yet thought-provoking narrative.

articles.title: European wrap: McTominay on the mark, Lens top in France
articles.summary: European football leagues saw significant outcomes. Napoli clinched a 1-0 victory over Cagliari in Serie A, courtesy of Scott McTominay's early goal, while Udinese secured a 2-0 win against Genoa. In France, Lens made a strong return to the top of the Ligue 1 table with a dominant 5-1 victory, impacting the league standings.

articles.title: Delhi High Court quashes look out circulars against NDTV founders
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court recently quashed Look Out Circulars (LOCs) issued in 2019 by the Bureau of Immigration against NDTV's former directors, Prannoy Roy and Radhika Roy. This decision provides significant relief to the prominent media figures, challenging the validity of the circulars that previously restricted their travel and impacting the ongoing legal proceedings concerning their cases.
